title.en: TikTok tool pages hand the parsed video to viral recreation
title.zh: TikTok 工具页可把解析好的视频带进爆款复刻

summary.en: On the TikTok video tool pages, Start recreating and Recreate with my character now open the workbench in viral recreation with the parsed 4-30 second video already in the reference video slot. Two same-site browser endpoints carry it; they are not part of the developer API.
summary.zh: 在 TikTok 视频工具页点「开始复刻」或「用我的角色复刻」，工作台会打开爆款复刻，并把解析好的 4–30 秒视频放进参考视频槽。由两个仅限本站页面调用的浏览器接口完成，不属于开发者 API。

body.en:
After a TikTok link is parsed on a tool page, Start recreating and Recreate with my character open `/influencer` in video mode with viral recreation selected, and the parsed video appears in the reference video slot. Videos must be 4-30 seconds long and at most 200 MiB.

The tool page calls `POST /api/tools/tiktok/handoff` with the parsed work ID only and receives a single-use token that expires after 30 minutes. The token does not contain the original link. The workbench calls `POST /api/tools/tiktok/handoff/redeem` after sign-in; OmniMux downloads the video again by work ID and stores it as the signed-in account's own reference upload, with the usual storage quota and expiry. A token works only for the guest browser or account that requested it, and only once.

The original link and media addresses never appear in the address bar, the token, or analytics. Guests who sign in from the workbench in the same tab keep their video. If the token has expired, was already used, or the video is unavailable, the workbench opens with an empty recreation slot and one message asking you to choose another video or upload a file.

Both endpoints accept requests from OmniMux pages only (same-origin and tool verification) and are not intended for API clients.
body.zh:
在工具页解析 TikTok 链接后，点「开始复刻」或「用我的角色复刻」会打开 `/influencer` 的视频模式并选中爆款复刻，解析好的视频直接出现在参考视频槽。视频须为 4–30 秒，且不超过 200 MiB。

工具页只把解析出的作品 ID 发给 `POST /api/tools/tiktok/handoff`，拿到一个 30 分钟内有效、只能使用一次的凭证；凭证不包含原链接。工作台在登录后调用 `POST /api/tools/tiktok/handoff/redeem`，OmniMux 按作品 ID 重新下载视频，存成当前登录账号自己的参考视频上传，照常计入存储配额并按期清理。凭证只对申请它的访客浏览器或账号有效，且只能用一次。

原链接和媒体地址不会出现在地址栏、凭证或统计数据里。访客在同一标签页从工作台登录后，视频仍会带上。凭证过期、已使用或视频不可用时，工作台打开空的爆款复刻槽，并提示一次请换一个视频或上传文件。

两个接口只接受来自 OmniMux 页面的请求（同源并需通过工具验证），不面向 API 客户端。
